decisions.decision: Guard SummaryWindow.commit() and minimize(skipCommit) with this.closed flag and readCache(..., skipTouch=true) inside syncFromStorage()
decisions.rationale: Prevents touchCacheIndex() or late minimize commits from resurrecting deleted win:<id> entries inside localStorage.__gm across concurrent tabs.

decisions.decision: Compare JSON.stringify(oldS[l.key]) !== JSON.stringify(newS[l.key]) in shim.js storage event listener
decisions.rationale: Stops unrelated GM storage mutations from firing spurious sync_ping callbacks in other tabs.

decisions.decision: Propagate e.stopPropagation() on .yt-win-overflow-btn / .yt-win-overflow-menu and add .yt-win-drag-grip + inline-block header link
decisions.rationale: Prevents global window click listeners from collapsing overflow menus immediately and guarantees a reliable drag handle even in compact (<540px) windows.

decisions.decision: Format LaTeX math ($100^\circ\text{C}$, \(...\) including parenthesized expressions, $$...$$, bare \circ/\text) via formatMathSymbolsInText() while preserving currency tokens like $100 to $200
decisions.rationale: Eliminates raw backslash TeX artifacts across summary UI, exports, and TTS without corrupting financial amounts.

decisions.decision: Remove temporary drag/resize cleanup callbacks from _interactionCleanup on mouseup in youtube-feed-summariser.user.js
decisions.rationale: Eliminates unbounded closure accumulation across repeated window drag/resize interactions in long-lived YouTube SPA sessions.

decisions.decision: Prompt-end sandbox backups to /sandbox-storage/backups/ + mandatory 3-role adversarial consensus gate per stage
decisions.rationale: Ensures deterministic rollback checkpoints after every completed prompt without noisy background timer churn, and prevents unvetted stage progression.

decisions.decision: Scope isDeArrowPresent() strictly per card/titleEl, preserve nested <yt-formatted-string> via getTitleTextTarget(), expand videoId match to {8,32}, deduplicate in-flight requests via altTitleInFlight, and enforce post-await DeArrow/settings checks
decisions.rationale: Prevents global DeArrow styles/thumbnail buttons or mid-flight async races from either suppressing AI titles on non-DeArrow cards or clobbering crowdsourced DeArrow titles, while enabling instant Settings reversion across tabs.

decisions.decision: Eliminate remaining innerHTML sinks (line 6078), enforce persistent GM alt_title_index LRU caps (500 keys), scope MutationObserver away from player/chat ticks, and validate dataset.ytaisVideoId against SPA node recycling
decisions.rationale: Identified during Stage 1B four-team adversarial audit (AUD-01 to AUD-04) to prevent Trusted Types exceptions on YouTube, persistent GM storage bloat, playback CPU thrash, and stale recycled card titles.

decisions.decision: Decompose src/App.tsx into modular src/components/* and introduce build-time shared-helper parity enforcement with youtube-feed-summariser.user.js alongside FEAT-01..06
decisions.rationale: Addresses AUD-08 monolith scale (12.1k userscript / 4.2k React) so mathematical, fallback, and title-resolution improvements cannot diverge across edits.
